fusions.name: Slipped Between Plates
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Palmed Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a blade that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden Barbs
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 35% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unsheathed Edge
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
